content: Get started fast. Go as far as your ideas take you Sign up for free. Set a spend limit for your project when you upgrade. Create an account Sign in Why choose AWS? Fast sign up: Create an account with a sign-in method you already have, such as Google or GitHub. No credit card required to start for most new customers. Up to $200 in Free Tier credits for new customers: Get started with $100 and earn up to $100 more as you explore key services. That’s up to $200 for up to 6 months or until your credits run out, whichever comes first. Hard spend cap: Set a spend limit at the project level. Workloads are paused at the limit. Connect your AI coding agent to AWS: Copy one prompt into your AI coding tool. Your agent gets access to your project and AWS knowledge, tools, and best practices. Smart and secure account defaults: Pre-configured so you can skip the setup and start shipping right away. Activate advanced AWS features anytime: Same account. No migration. No downtime. How your account works Get $100 in credits immediately as a new customer. Earn up to $100 more New customers are automatically enrolled in the Free plan and get $100 in AWS Free Tier credits immediately. Earn up to $100 more as you try out key services. Build and experiment over 6 months or until your credits run out, whichever comes first. No charges unless you upgrade to a paid plan. See what’s included in Free Tier. Connect your coding agent with one prompt After sign-up, connect Kiro, Claude Code, Codex, or any MCP-compatible agent to your AWS environment. One prompt installs the tools, knowledge, and skills your coding agent needs to help you build on AWS effectively. Invite your team by email. No IAM, no account setup Add teammates with an email address. They can create an account and get started fast, with no manual permissions setup or per-seat fees. Each teammate only gets access to the project they're invited to. Set a spend limit for your project On the Paid plan, you can choose a monthly spend limit for your project. If you hit it, your resources pause until the next month, or you can raise the limit and resume. Notifications at 50%, 75%, and 90% thresholds and optional early cost controls keep you in the know. Same account. Full AWS. No migration Activate advanced features in one step. You land in a pre-configured Organization with AWS best practices already applied. No migration, no new account, no downtime. Everything keeps running. Your existing projects become member accounts of the Organization. Using a coding agent? Copy and paste the following instructions to give your agent the tools, knowledge, and guardrails it needs to work effectively with AWS services. bash Copy Set up Agent Toolkit for AWS by following these instructions: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws/refs/heads/main/setup-instructions/setup.md Sign up and services 10 FAQs Sign up and services Open all How do I sign up for AWS? There are two ways to sign up for AWS. If you are a new user and want to use a login you already own, such as Google, GitHub, Apple, or Amazon, to sign in to AWS and create an AWS environment with sensible defaults in select AWS Regions, use Sign up for AWS (new) . When you sign up for AWS using Sign up for AWS (new), AWS creates an AWS Builder ID account, which is a personal profile that represents you as an individual. If you want complete control over account configuration and where your content is stored, or if you have regulated workloads, use Sign up for AWS (advanced) . To learn more about which sign-up is right for you, compare sign-up options . What is the AWS Free Tier program? The AWS Free Tier program allows new customers to explore AWS services at no cost for up to 6 months. New customers receive up to $200 in AWS credits—$100 upon sign-up and up to $100 more as you explore foundational AWS services. The AWS Free Tier program is available to all new customers—students, entrepreneurs, and small businesses are all welcome to sign up online. Learn more. Do I need a credit card to sign up? Most new customers will not be required to provide a payment method to get started. In some cases, we may ask for additional verification to protect your account. In addition, when you sign up for AWS, you might be ineligible for the free plan or Free Tier credits if you have an existing AWS account or have had one in the past. The Free plan and Free Tier credits are available only to new AWS customers. If you are ineligible for the Free Tier or Free plan, you'll need to provide payment information, and you'll be placed on the Paid plan. I’m a new customer. Why am I being asked to provide a payment method when I sign up? As part of our commitment to keeping AWS accounts secure, we occasionally request additional information, like a payment method, during sign-up. This is a routine security measure.
